title: USC cross-campus research discovery dataset
scope: 60 labs/centers/groups; 82 role/discovery records; 5 separate program/course/funding pathways; 6 project-period examples. Selective expansion, not a full directory harvest.
important_limitations: No opening independently confirmed with a lab. Page language is preserved with date/cycle caveats.
A group’s department is not automatically a required student major. Unknown major rules are not open-to-all claims.
Some entries are historical (2025–26), closed or discovery-only, not current openings.
CHLA entries are marked affiliated rather than USC-operated.
Research subjects/participants, nonresearch clinic volunteering and full-time technician/staff jobs were excluded from student opportunities.
Required and preferred qualifications, graduate application routes and faculty funding deadlines are separate.
Research methods describe lab work, not required student skills. Unpublished mentorship, training, international eligibility and tasks are not guessed.
Project/grant periods are stored separately from application windows and student time commitments.
DILL source says not recruiting; HaRVI future PhD position is tentative.
Some USC directory links are stale: water center site reports archived/suspended, CLVR domain fetch failed; neither was added as a verified active lab.
